high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from "Financial Express," specifically the section titled "Tech Bytes." The top of the page features the Financial Express logo and navigation tabs such as "Home," "News," "Gallery," "Reviews," and "Buying Guide." There is also a live event announcement for the "Chenab Bridge Inauguration." The main content of the page discusses Starlink's upcoming launch in India with competitive pricing. According to The Economic Times, Starlink will offer unlimited data plans priced below $10 per month (approximately Rs 857).
